meta.name: Paris Has Fallen
meta.description:
A protection officer and an MI6 operative team up after a terrorist attack. They suspect a mole as they race to thwart a larger conspiracy threatening Paris.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 23 Sept 2024 · France, Germany · Language: French
Studio: StudioCanal, Urban Myth Films, Millennium Media · Network: Canal+

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 8/8

On your server — Audio: French
meta.slogan: The threat is global. The mission is personal.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Vincent Taleb, close protection officer of Defense Minister Philippe Bardin, is deployed after an attack on the British embassy in Paris.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Vincent and Zara join an anti-terrorist task force set up to dismantle Pearce's group.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Jacob Pearce's mission for vengeance leads him to the people behind the attack that changed his life forever.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Vincent is still rocked by the revelation of the connection between Juliette and Pearce – will he be able focus on what really matters?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Pearce gives Juliette a terrifying deadline, but an investigative breakthrough puts Zara and Vincent back on top.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Jacob Pearce is at last in custody, but he still has one last card to play and he unleashes the full scale of his operation to escape.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Following Pearce's ultimatum, Zara and Vincent attempt a last-ditch effort to convert one of Jacob's allies.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: With Jacob Pearce's plan in motion, and the bomb's detonation imminent, Zara, Vincent and Juliette fear they must surrender.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The terrorist group Voltov kidnaps microbiologist Rachel Moss and forces her to create a deadly biological weapon. Zara and Vincent, who were monitoring Yuri Mishkin, the group's leader, must intervene to prevent the virus from being released and save Rachel.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Back in London, Zara realizes there's a mole within MI6. No longer knowing who to trust, she cuts off all official contact except with Karen, to whom she confides. In Benghazi, Rachel has to treat Vincent, who is seriously wounded. Vincent promises to help her escape if she saves him.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Zara warns Andrew, her superior, about a mole within MI6. But when he is murdered, Zara becomes the prime suspect. In Benghazi, Vincent and Rachel grow closer as they plan their escape.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Zara has found refuge with her former mentor, Keane. She is on the verge of unmasking the mole. In Benghazi, Vincent is infected with the MERS-CoV virus. Rachel is searching for a way to save him before the virus kills him.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Zara assembles a team of former mercenaries to capture Voltov. Vincent, who has managed to escape, finds refuge with Hassan, an interpreter he met on a previous mission. Yuri sets in motion the most devastating phase of his plan.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Keane, held back by Yuri, refuses to betray Zara. Meanwhile, with Hassan's help, Zara and Vincent attempt to infiltrate Voltov's base to rescue Rachel and the other hostages of the organization.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Zara and Vincent travel to Spain to find Rachel's family. Yuri is about to carry out his plan, but an unreliable source leaks it to Zara and Vincent, who are unsure whether to believe it.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Yuri realizes he has been betrayed. When Zara and Vincent arrive at his home to arrest him, they discover that his backup plan is already in motion: to contaminate a soccer stadium. They have only one hour left to prevent the virus from spreading.
